subject: Long project update: Q4 status and open risks
body:
Hi Waleed,

Here is the Q4 status update for the Apex integration project.

Progress: The data migration is 80% complete. We moved 1.6 million records from the legacy system and validated 1.2 million so far. Two tables (customers_archive and order_notes) still have encoding issues that need manual cleanup. The authentication module passed security testing last Thursday. The reporting dashboard is in user testing with five pilot users, who have raised 14 minor issues, none blocking.

Risks: First, the vendor has not confirmed the delivery date for the payment gateway sandbox, and without it we cannot test refunds. Second, our QA engineer is on leave from 24 to 30 November, which will slow regression testing. Third, the client has asked for a new export-to-Excel feature that was not in the original scope. I estimate it at 6 working days.

Decisions needed from you: (1) Approve or reject the Excel export feature by 20 November. (2) Choose whether to hire a temporary QA contractor for the leave period. (3) Confirm whether the go-live date of 15 December stays.

Next steps: I will finish the encoding cleanup by 19 November, chase the vendor again tomorrow, and send the pilot feedback summary on 18 November.

Let me know if you want a call to discuss.

Imran

expected.note: long email, 3 decisions needed, deadline Nov 20
